# ApollinaireASCII

> A Rust library, CLI and browser editor for static ASCII art, block lettering and animation made of
> real, selectable characters. Every frame is printable ASCII (bytes 32 to 126) in line-feed rows; there
> is no Unicode, Braille, colour, canvas, SVG or image artwork output. Images, GIFs, video and the
> browser camera are conversion inputs only. A fork of RASCII.

The crate is `apollinaire-ascii` and the command is `apollinaire`. Install the CLI with
`cargo install --locked apollinaire-ascii`, or download a release archive for Windows, macOS or Linux
on x86-64 or ARM64 with `SHA256SUMS.txt` (from v0.3.0 also build provenance attestations). The browser
editor at https://equitybot.github.io/ApollinaireASCII/ processes your files in the browser and uploads nothing.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII#readme): features, CLI and library quick start, browser build and checks.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/docs/CLI.md): commands and examples.
- [Library example](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/examples/library.rs): drawing, a generated scene and a JSON round trip.
- [Browser editor](https://equitybot.github.io/ApollinaireASCII/): drawing tools, diagram mode, lettering, effects, and image, video and camera conversion.

## Docs

- [Text and project format](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/docs/FORMAT.md): the frame and JSON project formats, fonts and resource limits.
- [Validation](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/docs/VALIDATION.md): checks run, reference comparisons with figlet and known limits.
- [Dependency scan](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md): dependency alerts, reachability and the in-house GIF decoder.
- [Research and provenance](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/docs/RESEARCH.md): the projects compared and why RASCII was chosen as the foundation.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): upstream code, font and dependency licences.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): the ASCII contract, reuse rules and checks.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/EquityBot/ApollinaireASCII/blob/master/SECURITY.md): reporting a vulnerability privately.

- [EquityBot](https://github.com/EquityBot): other EquityBot tools.
